title: Tax
lede: What this group is charged under, and what its settlement plans have assessed. Nothing here has been paid or remitted, and nothing on this screen changes anything.

rules.cardDescription: The tax rules in force right now, for the jurisdiction this deployment is configured with. Each row is a rate and the statute it encodes, so a figure on the report below can be traced back to the rule that produced it.
rules.caption: Rules in force, with the parameters they carry
rules.empty: No tax rule is in force for any currency this deployment holds, so a settlement cannot be assessed yet.

report.cardDescription: The tax the group's settlement plans have assessed, per currency, over the plans it has computed. These are the plan's own figures - the tax a cycle would be charged and what netting saved against settling every commitment pair by pair. They are not tax that has been collected or remitted: nothing in this build withholds tax, and the plans are waiting on the group.
report.backwards: That range ends before it starts, so nothing can be in it. Swap the two dates to ask about a period.
report.empty: No plan has been computed in that period, so there is no tax to report. A period nobody has settled in is an empty report rather than an error.
report.caption: Assessed tax by currency, over the plans the period contains
report.perCurrencyNote: Nothing on this screen is added up across currencies, and nothing should be: rupees and yen have no common total without a reporting currency and a rate nobody agreed, which is why the report has no headline figure and the request offers no way to ask for one.
